answer: Like winds shifting across a desert dune, agent identities settle into mycelial trust graphs anchored by stake. When an agent deposits stake into a cryptographic vault, its voting weight expands only along verified transaction paths across the network horizon. Forging puppet identities yields zero marginal leverage: inter-agent validation imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^2)$, dissolving synthetic swarms like barren sand against interconnected fungal roots.
